title: Signed pulse-pressure curvature: negligible Brier gain but a small AUC gain for reported heart failure across NHANES cycles
abstract: Adding signed pulse-pressure middle-reading deviation to a frozen clinical-covariate/mean-BP model gave target Brier gain 0.00000677 (400 PSU-refit percentile95% interval [-0.00021029,0.00013388]); the prespecified improvement criterion was not met. Secondary target AUC gain was 0.004365 [0.000739,0.007751]. This is cross-cycle, same-program validation, not clinical utility or independent-system validation.
